footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to NiSource: after $83.1M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 21.8% to $6.6B in 2025. Gross margin was 76.1%, versus 79.2% a year earlier, and operating income rose 26.1% to $1.8B, a 27.6% margin.
Net income rose 22.2% to $930M, or $1.95 per share. Operating cash flow was $2.4B and free cash flow −$420M, versus −$832M; NiSource returned $530M through dividends.
sources: NiSource Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
